description: Hexagonal Business Architecture pack: immutable Single Source of Truth ledgers (corporate/ledgers/), Business AAA policies/SOPs (corporate/policies/), and multi-surface compliance cascade (surfaces/{web,forms,print}/)

recommended_surface_bindings.description: Hexagonal business boundary (Inner Ledgers -> Normative Policies/SOPs -> Outer Surfaces), [DEPT]-[TYPE]-[YYYY]-[NNN] citation traceability, and Business AAA verification gates
invariants: Outer surfaces (surfaces/web/**, surfaces/forms/**, surfaces/print/**) never invent financial figures, legal clauses, or batch metrics; every claim cites an immutable Inner Ledger ID ([DEPT]-[TYPE]-[YYYY]-[NNN]) in corporate/ledgers/

Every policy, contract, or operational SOP in corporate/policies/ and corporate/sops/ follows the Three-Part Business AAA structure (# Scope & Surface Target, # Normative Invariants, # Verification & Sign-Off Gates)

Enforce the World Novelty & Trade Secret Firewall before publishing to surfaces/: reference restricted assets by opaque ID (<PAT-ID>, <TS-ID>, Batch #NNN) without exposing confidential formulas or unfiled IP
